readme.summary: Well-structured docs with good command coverage and configuration detail, but lacks troubleshooting guidance and installation instructions are incomplete.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section — common issues like tmux not found, config not loading, or fuzzy finder failures are undocumented.

injection_risks.description: The use of `std::env::args_os()` and `clap` to parse command line arguments may lead to potential injection risks if not properly sanitized.
The use of `Command` from the `std::process` module may pose a risk if the command is constructed with user input, but in this case it seems to be used safely.

critical_findings: Potential injection risks due to command line argument parsing
